messages:
Mira: heads-up — CI red on macOS-latest for runtime retry test: TestRetrySemantics failing intermittently. link: https://ci.internal/runs/7421
Josh: saw that. rate about 1/20? any failing seed in logs?
Mira: no seed printed, just `t.Fatalf("expected retry")` and a stack trace into serve/retry manager.
Priya: can someone trigger a rerun? i'll also try a seed sweep. @CI-Bot can you rerun job 7421?
CI-Bot: Re-run requested by Priya for job 7421. queued 4 attempts.
Alex: quick local repro recipe i used: `go test ./runtime/serve -run TestRetrySemantics -count=50 -v` on mac VM — reproduced once after ~12 runs.
Josh: nice, can you paste the failing snippet?
Alex: ```
--- FAIL: TestRetrySemantics (0.23s)
    retry_test.go:87: expected 3 retries, got 2
```
Mira: stack implies timer fired earlier than expected — maybe backoff jitter change from PR #814.
Priya: if it's that PR we should either pin the old backoff in CI to unblock or bisect to confirm. what's our tolerance?
Mira: i own the PR. i'd prefer a quick bisect first but can open a small interim fix if it's blocking releases.
Josh: timeline rule: if bisect > 2h, pin and follow up.
Alex: i'll try a quick bisect locally across last 10 commits, run same `-count=100` stress. will report commit hash if found.
CI-Bot: Rerun results: attempt 1 failed, attempts 2-4 passed.
Josh: noisy flake. low-effort mitigation: bump mac test timeout or run the flaky test with a fixed seed in CI debug job.
Mira: i'll draft PR to increase test timeout and set TEST_SEED=42 for the flaky job; also add a debug job that runs `-run TestRetrySemantics -count=200`.
Priya: assign to Mira. if SRE can schedule a debug window we can collect more runs.
Alex: bisect tip: `git bisect start HEAD <good-sha>` then run the repro script inside the CI container so env matches.
SRE-ops: scheduled debug job debug-7421 at 2024-11-02T15:00:00Z. will give 2h access.
Mira: PR 821 opened: https://git.internal/pr/821 — increases timeout, pins seed, and adds debug job config. kicking off debug job now.
Josh: thanks — please paste debug job logs when available. :thumbsup:
Mira: will follow up with findings. closing this thread for now unless it regresses.
Priya: thanks all.
